verdict.rationale: Self-configured background automation is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies, but the pack shows no Bitwarden feature for defining automations that run on their own. The CLI, the personal API key described as 'suitable for automated workflows', `bw serve`, the Public API and the MCP server are developer building blocks that would need an external scheduler or agent. Built-in TOTP generation and code sync are adjacent features, not user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
